milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the center of the cobblestone stairs pyramid at spawn-relative (10, 1, 10) — the stairs span from (6,0,6) to (14,2,14) so (10,1,10) is the volumetric center. max_distance=16 is generous since the pyramid is a large 3-tier structure visible from a distance. facing_tolerance=60° ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure, not just nearby. This rule was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks should verify the player can SEE the target, not just be near it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the beacon block at spawn-relative (10, 4, 10), matching the /setblock ~10 ~4 ~10 command. max_distance=10 is tighter than the stairs milestone because the beacon is a single small block at the pyramid apex — the player must approach closer to meaningfully identify it. This tighter distance also naturally enforces the task dependency: the player must walk toward the structure (past the stairs milestone threshold) to reach the beacon milestone threshold. facing_tolerance=60° ensures the player is looking up toward the beacon at the top of the pyramid.
